title: Create Image Comparison Node - side-by-side comparison of two images with slider overlay
description: Build a new node type that accepts two image inputs and displays them in a side-by-side comparison view with a draggable slider overlay. Include zoom sync between both images and a swap button.

title: Add Batch Variations Node - generate multiple image variations from single prompt
description: Create a node that takes an image and prompt, generates N variations (configurable 2-8), and outputs them as a grid. Include progress indicator and ability to select/favorite individual results.

title: Implement Conditional Branch Node - if/else logic based on image analysis
description: Build a conditional node that analyzes input image properties (dimensions, dominant color, brightness) and routes to different output handles based on conditions. Support AND/OR logic for multiple conditions.
